subject: Aids to Navigation - Vancouver Harbour
text:
Aids to Navigation - Vancouver Harbour
Berry Point Range Rear LL 411.2 established in Vancouver Harbour at 49 17.761N 122 59.168W.
Dayboard is trapezoidal, red with a white strip and a range of 2.5NM. 
Light is fixed yellow with a nominal range of 12.42NM bearing 087 degrees.
